name: IDM and experimental electronic
lineage: Early-1990s onward experimental-electronic genre intentionally constructed for headphone listening rather than club-dance use, characterized by complex broken-beat programming, glitchy textural sound design, and the post-acid-house compositional ambition — codified through Aphex Twin (Selected Ambient Works 85-92 in 1992, Richard D. James Album 1996), Autechre (Tri Repetae 1995), Boards of Canada (Music Has the Right to Children 1998), Squarepusher, the Warp Records Artificial Intelligence series
recipe: classic 1990-1993 idm and experimental electronic, experimental Elec, idm glitch branch, musique concrete experimental electric. drum machine analog, pad like pad analog synth, sampler drum machine. treated studio. dynamic moving-coil, transformer-coupled solid-state pre, dbx 160 VCA, parametric EQ. cassette TC electronic 2290 delay pitch shifter ring modulator.
